comment: uhitm.c disguised_as_non_mon() through zap.c buzz(). A wizard-mode elven Priest wears an amulet of ESP, creates a giant mimic, which takes an object disguise next to her, and zaps a wand of sleep at it. Unblind telepathy makes the mimic sensed as well as seen, so disguised_as_non_mon() is false and C prints "The sleep ray misses the giant mimic." when the first pass misses. The elf's sleep resistance keeps the bounced ray from putting her to sleep.
